# total_bytes is payload bytes encrypted per launch (Ascon tags excluded).
# sm_mhz_kernel: median over SMs of clock64 cycles / %globaltimer ns over each SM's span
#   recorded in one extra launch of the same kernel right after the timed ones; sms_seen = SMs
#   that reported. probe_mhz_before/after: a clock64() spin kernel around the row (context only).
# bytes_per_sm_cycle = throughput / (sm_mhz_kernel x SM count). Scaling it to another clock is a
#   compute-bound estimate only; memory bandwidth and latency do not scale with the SM clock.
